You need a smaller site so your app won't get buried on day one, and if enough people vote for it, you get a free link to your site. I put all 5 links on one page. tiktok.author: thelazydeveloper
tiktok.body:
producthunt is a scam I think
I think Product Hunt is a scam. Probably an unpopular opinion. Hear me out, here's my experience. I've done two launches on Product Hunt and both of them, I would say have been pretty rubbish in all honesty. But what I have gotten out of it are a bunch of companies who've seen my listing on Product Hunt and decided to email me to sell their services. Which is completely pointless because that doesn't benefit me at all I'm trying to do is use it as a platform to boost my own app. But instead, when you look at the numbers after doing it twice, it makes you think that basically you're just trying to tell everyone you know to upvote you so that you can get higher up the ladder or the leaderboard so that you get more people to notice you. But if you're not in the top 30, you basically are hidden to everyone else. And it's pretty easy to see that because in the top 30 you'll see they have a big amount of upvotes 20, 30, 40, 60 hundred. And as soon as you go past the fold of 30 to 31, the numbers drop from 20, 30 to like three, and then basically the next hundred and fifty apps on there are sitting at three or four or two upvotes. So if you don't get into the top 30, you get nowhere. And how do you get into the top 30 where you have To promote and advertise and work hard to get your app going. But I have a little bit of distribution. I tried to use that, approached a few people but I don't wanna just go to friends and family and say hey upload me. I would like to go to people that I think have an interest in my app. They try it out and they upvote me because they think the app is valuable. That's kinda how I think it works. But it doesn't work like that at all. You basically just have to flog everyone you know to get them to upvote you so you can get into the top 30 so that you get recognised. But then the downside of that is probably that even more companies will see you. They'll try to sell you what is their offering as well. So in all honesty, my recommendation, I give it a 3 out of 10. It's a great platform to like, put the stuff on, but it's not a good platform to actually use to promote your app. So skip it. Find your own path.
